title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Rate Class for Demurrage Days by Booking Cargo Type
content:
## Rule

On a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record, demurrage days are priced in the rate class that the equipment class map assigns to the container, subject to a single qualification tied to the booking. For reefer-class equipment the booking decides: reefer cargo on the booking keeps the unit on reefer-class demurrage, whereas any other cargo type puts it on dry-class demurrage.

Every demurrage day then takes the demurrage rate that the product on the record quotes for the day's slab in that class.

## Condition, judgement, outcome

| Condition: mapped class | Condition: booking cargo type | Outcome: demurrage priced as |
|---|---|---|
| dry | any | dry |
| special | any | special |
| reefer | reefer | reefer |
| reefer | not reefer | dry |

## Points of judgement

- The booking consulted is the one under which the container is moving, the same booking to which the free-time record is tied.
- The qualification touches reefer-class units alone; dry and special units keep their mapped class whatever the cargo type.
- A reefer unit that is re-priced as dry is priced as dry for every one of its demurrage days, not for some of them.

**Q: Which demurrage scale applies to a reefer-mapped box whose booking carries reefer cargo?**
The reefer-class demurrage scale of the product on the record.
